category_title: Verified Online Gold Ring Sellers — Reputation, Return Policies, Resizing Exclusions & Payment Protection

sellers.name: Ross-Simons, Inc.
sellers.headquarters_address: 9 Ross Simons Dr, Cranston, RI 02920-4475, USA
sellers.bbb_customer_rating: 4.43 / 5 (544 reviews; 35 complaints in 3 yrs, 7 in last 12 mos)
sellers.gram_weight_transparency: Partial — Publishes approximate gram weights on plain/signet gold bands (Items 571221, 571212, 823796, 964717, 993085 carry caveat 'All weights and measurements are approximate.'); omitted on diamond solitaires.
sellers.return_shipping_terms: Shipping & handling non-refundable; flat $4.95 return label fee may apply via Loop portal; insure package for full invoice value.
sellers.resized_custom_exclusions: Merchandise that has been damaged, altered, or resized by a jeweler other than Ross-Simons CANNOT be accepted for return.
sellers.accepted_payments: Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, Apple Pay, PayPal (US), Affirm
sellers.wire_transfer_risk_note: No bank wire discount trap; standard major credit cards fully accepted for Fair Credit Billing Act dispute protection.
sellers.checklist_grade: PASS (Top Overall Traditional Value & Published Band Gram Weights)
flagged_notes: Catalog sells BOTH solid karat gold AND gold-plated/gold-over-sterling items (e.g., Item 241592 '14kt Yellow Gold over Brass')—always verify the Metal spec table line by line.
Found 10kt vs 14kt copy contradiction on Item 251663; product pages omit hallmark photos and note 'All weights and measurements are approximate.'

sellers.name: Blue Nile, Inc. (Signet Jewelers)
sellers.bbb_customer_rating: 1.0 / 5 (25 BBB reviews; 121 complaints in 3 yrs, 23 in last 12 mos)
sellers.gram_weight_transparency: Omitted on standard engagement ring product pages — requires live chat/phone inquiry prior to purchase.
sellers.return_shipping_terms: Free insured return shipping label within 30 days of shipment (limit 2 complimentary returns per customer per year; RMA required on outside of box; $150 replacement fee if diamond certificate is missing).
sellers.resized_custom_exclusions: STRICT EXCLUSION: Personalized jewelry, custom orders, engraved items, AND items resized after initial purchase are NOT eligible for return or exchange.
sellers.accepted_payments: Major Credit Cards, Debit Cards, PayPal, Blue Nile Credit Card, Bank Wire ($1,000+)
sellers.wire_transfer_risk_note: WARNING (CHECKLIST #8): Offers a 1.5% discount on bank wires >= $1,000, which forfeits credit card chargeback protection. Prefer credit card despite the 1.5% spread.
sellers.checklist_grade: CONDITIONAL PASS (Request Gram Weight First; Skip Engraving & Bank Wire)
flagged_notes: Never add free engraving at initial purchase—engraving voids 30-day return eligibility immediately, and missing grading certificates incur a $150 fee.
Have an independent jeweler verify karat purity via XRF BEFORE utilizing Blue Nile's 1 free resize within 1 year, because resized rings become non-returnable.

sellers.checklist_grade: CONDITIONAL PASS (Check Individual Ring Resize Exclusion & Prong Metal)

sellers.checklist_grade: FLAGGED FOR REVIEW (7-Day Return Window, Up to 10% Restocking Fee & Unanswered BBB Complaint)
